statements.text: Parent reports poor sleep with waking three or four times every night for about six months, since moving house.

citations.quote: She wakes up three or four times every night.
For about six months, since we moved house.
During the day she is very restless.

statements.text: No current medicines. Parent reports an allergy to amoxicillin (rash).

citations.quote: No medicines now. She is allergic to amoxicillin, she got a rash.

statements.text: Active, brief eye contact, growth normal for age.

citations.quote: On examination she is active, makes brief eye contact and her growth is normal for her age.

statements.text: Asked for bubbles with two words three times during play.

citations.quote: During play she asked me for the bubbles with two words three times.

statements.text: Clinician to confirm: impression of a sleep onset and night waking problem; low iron to be checked.

citations.quote: My impression is a sleep onset and night waking problem, and I want to check for low iron.
we will check a blood count and ferritin.

statements.text: Start melatonin 2 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth 30 minutes before bed, for 30 days.

citations.quote: Start melatonin two milligram tablet, one tablet by mouth thirty minutes before bed, for thirty days.

statements.text: Fixed bedtime routine with no screens for one hour before bed.

citations.quote: Keep a fixed bedtime routine with no screens for one hour before bed.

statements.text: Follow up in four weeks with a sleep diary.

citations.quote: Please come back for follow up in four weeks with a sleep diary.

goal_suggestions.quote: During play she asked me for the bubbles with two words three times.
goal_suggestions.rationale: The clinician counted three two-word requests for bubbles during play.
